name: Vietnamese_Embedding_v2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-04-30.
